presentation: Patient is a 44-year old man who had a positive quantiferon as part of a routine medical examination given he is from an endemic country. He has no symptoms other than mild seasonal allergic rhinitis and no known TB exposures. His chest-xray was negative for infection during his clinic visit today. He would like to delay TB treatment if not absolutely necessary for at least a few months. Does this patient need immediate TB treatment and if so, with what regimen?
